By leveraging state-of-the-art AI technology, we help learners build real-world confidence, expand their vocabulary, and master conversation styles at their own pace.

admin.lang_how_body: Published languages appear in every language picker. Draft languages are hidden from the lists but still work through a direct link (e.g. ?ui_lang=ru), so they can be prepared quietly. Disabled languages are rejected. Interface strings come from lang/<code>.json in the repo; AI translations and your edits are stored in the database on top of it. Anything missing shows in English. Use Download JSON to commit a finished language into the repo.

cookie.s2_1: Essential Cookies: Required to keep you logged in to your account and store temporary session settings.

faq.a1_1: Jumplearner is an AI-powered conversational language tutor. It simulates real-life chat scenarios, allowing you to practice in your target language. When you make mistakes, the AI provides instant corrections and explanations.
faq.a2_1: You can practice English, Spanish, German, French, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and more. During onboarding, you can select your native language and the target language you wish to learn.
faq.a3_1: Our AI is CEFR-aware. It adapts the vocabulary density and complexity of sentences according to your selected proficiency level (from A1 Beginner to C2 Proficiency). You can change this level anytime from your dashboard.
faq.a4_1: Every new word or concept you encounter or struggle with during chats is saved to your personal vocabulary notebook. You can view definitions, translations, and example sentences to practice later.
faq.a5_1: Yes, we offer a 30-day full refund policy for your initial purchase if you are not satisfied. Please contact support or read our Refund Policy page for more details.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Jumplearner, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, process, and protect your information when you use our service.
privacy.s1_1: Account Information: Name, email address, password, and registration date.
privacy.s1_2: Learning Preferences: Native language, target language, proficiency level (CEFR), and learning goals.
privacy.s1_3: Chat Logs: The text messages exchanged with our AI tutor to track your progress and generate feedback.
privacy.s1_4: Payment & Billing: Transaction identifiers and plan status processed securely via our payment gateway (Paddle). We do not store raw credit card details.
privacy.s1_intro: We collect information to provide a personalized language learning experience:
privacy.s2_1: To operate and maintain your personalized AI tutor sessions.
privacy.s2_2: To generate grammar corrections, vocabulary cards, and learning progress statistics.
privacy.s2_3: To manage your active plan and process payments securely via Paddle.
privacy.s2_4: To send you transactional notifications, security alerts, and support responses.
privacy.s2_intro: Your data is processed for the following purposes:
privacy.s3_1: Google Gemini API: Message prompts are sent to Gemini to generate tutor replies (excluding your direct account credentials).
privacy.s3_2: Paddle: Payment details are processed entirely by Paddle to handle subscriptions, billing, and compliance.
privacy.s3_intro: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We share data only with trusted subprocessors necessary to deliver our services, such as:
privacy.s4_body: We deploy secure database procedures and encryption to safeguard your information. Our service adheres to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) standards. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting support.

refund.s1_body: If you are unsatisfied with Jumplearner within 30 days of your first payment, contact support for a full refund.
refund.s2_body: After 30 days, refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis depending on technical issues, account usage, and platform compliance.
refund.s3_body: You can cancel your subscription at any time from the Pricing page in your account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period — you keep full access until then and will not be charged again afterwards. Cancelling does not automatically trigger a refund for the current period.

tips.heading: Chat Instructions
tips.section_1_body: Kai is your AI language tutor — not a general chatbot. Every response is designed to help you practice, learn new words, and improve your grammar. Kai adjusts vocabulary and sentence complexity based on your CEFR level (A1–C2).
tips.section_2_tip_1: Write in your target language as much as possible.
tips.section_2_tip_2: Short sentences are fine — so are long ones. Kai adapts to you.
tips.section_2_tip_3: Don't worry about mistakes — Kai will gently correct them.
tips.section_2_tip_4: You can mix in your native language if you get stuck; Kai will still understand.
tips.section_2_tip_5: Ask questions like "How do I say …?" or "Is this correct?"
tips.section_3_body: Click a topic chip to start a themed role-play. Kai will play the other role:
tips.section_4_tip_1: Set a daily goal of writing at least 5 messages.
tips.section_4_tip_2: Read Kai's corrections carefully and try to apply them.
tips.section_4_tip_3: Use the vocabulary flashcards to review new words.
tips.section_4_tip_4: Don't be afraid to repeat the same topic to build confidence.
